content.overview: Article 145 empowers the Supreme Court, with the approval of the President, to make rules for regulating generally the practice and procedure of the Court, including rules as to persons practising before it, procedure for hearing appeals and other matters, conditions for review, fees, grant of bail, stay of proceedings, and other listed subjects. It also provides for minimum numbers of Judges for certain classes of matters (including Constitution Benches for substantial questions of law as to the interpretation of the Constitution).
content.glance: SC makes rules of practice and procedure with President’s approval. Minimum Judge numbers for classes of cases; Constitution Bench for substantial constitutional questions.
content.study:
Article 145:
(1) SC may, with the approval of the President, make rules for regulating generally the practice and procedure of the Court (detailed heads listed in the article).
(2)–(3) Provision as to minimum number of Judges for hearing certain matters; no fewer than five Judges for deciding a case involving a substantial question of law as to the interpretation of the Constitution (Constitution Bench), subject to the article’s terms.

Examination: rule-making with Presidential approval; Constitution Bench requirement; link to review (Art 137) and practice.

sections.heading: Key points
sections.body:
1. Rules of practice and procedure: SC with approval of the President.
2. Minimum Judge strength for classes of matters.
3. Substantial constitutional questions: minimum five Judges (Constitution Bench), as provided in the article.

questionsAndAnswers.question: Who makes the rules of the Supreme Court?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Under Article 145, the Supreme Court may, with the approval of the President, make rules for regulating generally the practice and procedure of the Court. The article also provides for the minimum number of Judges for hearing certain classes of matters, including a requirement of not less than five Judges for deciding cases involving a substantial question of law as to the interpretation of the Constitution.

examTips: Rules with President’s approval; Constitution Bench of at least five for substantial constitutional questions.

keyTakeaways: Art 145: SC rules of court; Constitution Bench strength.
